top_deficiency_types.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.
Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.
Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Create and put into place a plan for meeting the resident's most immediate needs within 48 hours of being admitted
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.
